{{Quote|My ''squash melons!'' Look what you've done!|Brador|<ref name="e14" />}}
'''Squash melons''' were a type of round, [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]. When they exploded, a yellow liquid emerged from inside.<ref name="e14" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which include the events of [[Ewoks (1985) 14|''Ewoks'' 14]], to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Brador]] was attempting to use his [[Bordok/Legends|bordok]] to move a [[Wagon/Legends|wagon]] filled with squash [[Melon/Legends|melons]]. However, the bordok was uncooperative and refused to move. [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], a [[Youngling/Legends|young]] Ewok who had been designated as the [[Chief/Legends|leader]] of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|village]] for that [[Standard day/Legends|day]], tried to help Brador by whacking his bordok's rear end. The act only infuriated the bordok, however, and it began galloping all over the village, causing chaos.<ref name="e14" />

Many melons fell out of the wagon as the bordok ran, with some exploding on an Ewok's [[Clothing/Legends|laundry]] and a newly built hut. The bordok eventually calmed down, but the villagers were furious with Teebo and sought to drive him away from the village. Teebo used a [[Hang-glider/Legends|hang glider]] to escape, and when he returned, he gathered some of the fallen melons and put them in a box.<ref name="e14" />

==Behind the scenes==
Squash melons appeared in the [[Ewoks (1985) 14|fourteenth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[David Manak]], illustrated by [[Warren Kremer]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="e14" /> on [[March 31]], [[1987]].<ref name="MarvelAge">{{BookCite|title=[[Marvel Age]]|number=Vol. 1 No. 51|publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] Group|date=[[June]] [[1987]]|issn=8750-4367}}</ref> While the melons were initially drawn as gray, later frames depict them as orange. Since the frames that depict them as gray come first and outnumber those that color the melons as orange,<ref name="e14" /> this article assumes that the later frames were an error.
